about_the_game:
Grab your club/hammer, the Stone Age is back and bigger than ever!

For the first time, three legendary adventures from the Joe & Mac universe are united in a single collection. Step back in time and join your favorite cavemen in their wildest escapades through jungle mayhem, fighting dinos, and stone-age fun.

Joe&Mac Caveman Ninja: The original arcade hit that started it all. Rescue the village’s women from a gang of Neanderthals and face off against deadly dinos.

Congo’s Caper: A wacky spin-off full of high-flying action, mischievous monkeys and even more prehistoric madness.

Joe&Mac Lost in the Tropics: A tropical sequel where our heroes get new weapons, face new enemies and must defend the Tiki Village

Three full games, one epic Stone Age experience. Whether you are a nostalgic fan or a curious newcomer, this collection is your ticket to relive or discover the colorful chaos of Joe & Mac.

Welcome to the pre-hysterical jungle!

Get ready to experience Joe&Mac like never before! With a whole suite of fresh features, your prehistoric journey just got smoother, sharper and more fun than ever.

• Rewind: Missed a jump or made a wrong move? No worries, rewind time get back into action. Just like in the good old days, but with a modern twist!

• Savestate: Never lose you progress again! Save your game at any point and pick up right where you left off, no matter how many dino battles you’ve survived.

• CRT Filter: For the true retro experience, turn on the CRT filter and enjoy the authentic old-school vibes, complete with that pixel-perfect charm and grainy goodness

• Custom Frames: Personalize your adventure! Choose from a variety of custom frames to make you Stone Age experience feel uniquely yours.

• "Boss Rush" mode: A new game mode exclusive to the Collection: prepare yourself to face bosses from each of the three games in the compilation one after the other, and challenge yourself to defeat them all the fastest you can!

Wether you’re reliving the classic games or playing for the first time, these features ensure your Joe&Mac adventure is as fun and accessible as ever.

Time to step back into the wild with a little extra help from modern tech.

Three games, three unique environments to explore

Travel through colorful and perilous landscape, each with its own visual style and prehistoric flavor.

Across all three games, you’ll experience a wide range of settings, from jungle chaos to volcanic traps… even the stomach of a dinosaur!

  • Joe & Mac: Caveman Ninja

Fight your way through dense forests, icy caves, volcanic lands, eerie lakes and dark mountains. Culminating in a wild ride through the stomach of a dinosaur! The original arcade adventure throws challenge after challenge at you… right down to a towering fossilized skeleton boss. Even the remains of ancient beasts will try to stop you from reaching your goal.

  • Congo’s Caper

Dash and bounce through exotic forests, dive into a vast ocean or explore dark caverns in this colorful spin-off packed with energy, traps, and prehistoric madness. It’s lighter in tone, but just as action-packed.

  • Joe & Mac: Lost in the Tropics

Start your journey in a peaceful Tiki Village you can customize, then set off to recover the stolen royal crown. Along the way, you’ll travel through lush jungles, murky swamps and snowy peaks collecting the legendary Rainbow Stones and facing off against wild enemies.

Each game offers its own distinct world and a lineup of increasingly fearsome bosses. Get ready for a wild ride through the Stone Age!

Because bashing dinos is better with a buddy! Play together, just like back in the day.

Staying true to the arcade spirit of the ‘90s, this collection lets you relive the joys of local multiplayer on the same screen, old school style.

Face dinosaurs, avoid traps and survive bosses together in local two-player co-op.

  • Local two-player multiplayer on the same screen

  • Classic co-op mechanics: each player manages their own health, competing for meat and helping each other amidst the chaos

  • An intact arcade spirit: no modern gimmicks, just two players and tons of dinos to bash

Joe & Mac is better with two players. Whether you’re replaying with an older friend or introducing the game to someone new, get ready to relive the Stone Age… as a team!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo E8400, 3.0GHz or AMD Athlon 64 X2 6000+, 3.0GHz or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 9600 GT or AMD HD 3870 512MB or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sounds cards

short_description: Fight huge dinosaurs and crafty cavemen while looking for the tribe's kidnapped damsels in this retro collection featuring the three Joe & Mac SNES games!
supported_languages: English, Japanese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese
